video_title: Steph Curry Opens Up About Aging, Retirement & The End Of His NBA Career

quotes.speaker: Steph Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry on his physical preparation and energy for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: I'm excited about where we're at and where I'm at physically to get back to my game.
quotes.quote: I'm excited, man. I feel good. It's been too long of an off-season. Obviously when you don't make the playoffs, you get those extra couple months, but it's been a great recharge, refresh. I'm going into year 18, which is insane. I'm excited about where we're at and where I'm at physically to get back to my game. As you go, that energy going into training camp is electric and I love it, so I'm ready.

quotes.speaker: Steph Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry on the Warriors' championship aspirations and need for health
quotes.excerpt: We still believe that we can be that team. I think our challenge now is to reimagine.
quotes.quote: We have a high standard and a high bar, high expectation being with the Warriors. Until you ask me, ask Steph Curry, ask Draymond, we still believe that we can be that team. I think our challenge now is to reimagine what that looks like. We have a veteran team, we need health on our side, there's no questions about that. We have some young guys that are ready to come in and have an impact.

quotes.speaker: Steph Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry explains his keratoconus diagnosis and the importance of early screening
quotes.excerpt: I found out I had a condition called keratoconus that is a sight-threatening condition.
quotes.quote: I found out I had a condition called keratoconus that is a sight-threatening condition that disproportionately affects young African American, Latino communities in the early adulthood. I was trying to understand what that meant, what the possible treatments could be, but I only had those answers because I had access to go get screened. If your vision doesn't feel right, or you know something's off, don't wait, make sure you go get checked.

quotes.speaker: Steph Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry on how his aging process has changed his preparation and mindset
quotes.excerpt: It just changes the way that I prepare and my mindfulness of everything that I do.
quotes.quote: What it really means at this point is it just changes the way that I prepare and my mindfulness of everything that I do to put into my game. I do train differently than I used to. There's a different mentality of all season, in-season, all the things that need to go into me playing at the highest level. But more so, it's just giving me a gratitude that at year 18, this is kind of unheard of in the sense of, you got Bron, you got guys, he's the only one, but you got guys that are still capable of moving the needle on the court.

quotes.speaker: Steph Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry on his relationship with Draymond Green and his move to Miami
quotes.excerpt: Me and Draymond, we grew up as adults, we grew up as competitors, as champions.
quotes.quote: Me and Draymond, we grew up as adults, we grew up as competitors, as champions. At the end of the day, when it is all said and done, I can't wait for us to break bread, have a glass of bourbon and reminisce on all the things that we were able to accomplish. I'm happy for him in Miami, I know he wants to be in a situation where he can be impactful, have a championship contending kind of energy going into the season, that's I think what they have.

quotes.speaker: Steph Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry identifies health as the biggest obstacle to the Warriors' success
quotes.excerpt: It's health. I missed whatever so many games last year. We got KP, Draymond, guys who know.
quotes.quote: It's health. I missed whatever so many games last year. We got KP, Draymond, guys who know how to win big games when it matters and for us, if we can stay healthy, have a consistent lineup as much as possible throughout the regular season, I feel like we showed enough last year and when guys were missing, you saw how much it hurt. Every team needs health on their side, I think some more than others and I know everybody is working to prepare themselves for the gauntlet of an NBA season coming up.
